item.title: Kon'ya, Tsuma ga Chichi ni Dakaremasu...
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nomad
  • 発売日: 2015-11-27
  • スコア: 7.05/10 (63 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 今夜、妻が父に抱かれます…
  • 英語名: Kon’ya, Tsuma ga Chichi ni Dakaremasu…

あらすじ

Takeru has feelings for his older childhood friend, Takizawa Haruka. Haruka moves to Tokyo for further studies, and Takeru promises to join her there in a year. After a year, he reunites with her in Tokyo, and they confess their feelings to each other. The seasons change, and they return to their hometown. Takeru becomes a teacher at his old school, and Haruka works as a shrine maiden at her family’s shrine. Their relationship goes well, and they eventually get married. Takeru believes that happiness is within his grasp.

  • 日本語名: 今夜、おじ様に抱かれます…
  • 英語名: Kon’ya, Oji-sama ni Dakaremasu…

あらすじ

Hina has admired Takeru since childhood. However, Takeru marries Hina’s sister, making him a more distant figure in her life. She’s still happy to be working alongside him as a teacher at the same school. Unfortunately, Takeru’s father, Gouzou, becomes aware of Hina’s feelings. Although she has a youthful face, her body is maturing as a woman. Gouzou sets a trap to make Hina his own.

item.title: Kon'ya, Otou-sama ni Dakaremasu...
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nomad
  • 発売日: 2014-11-28
  • スコア: 7.58/10 (91 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 今夜、お義父様に抱かれます…
  • 英語名: Kon’ya, Otou-sama ni Dakaremasu…

あらすじ

Takeru married his childhood friend, Haruka. His career as a teacher at their old school is going well, and he receives positive feedback from colleagues and students. When he returns home, his beloved wife Haruka greets him with a smile. Takeru feels fulfilled and happy both in his personal and professional life. However, unbeknownst to him, his happiness is threatened by his own father and Haruka’s father-in-law, Gouzou. He demands Haruka’s body in exchange for helping Takeru out of a difficult situation. Haruka agrees to have a one night stand with Gouzou, on the condition that Takeru never finds out.

There is something wrong. Nanami, who lost her parents, has come to a small island to live with her uncle, Haruhiko. Since he is the chief priest of a shrine, he is respected by islanders. But Nanami sometimes feels that someone is watching her. She tries to forget it, but it is actually true. One night, Haruhiko tells her to wear a miko uniform for the upcoming shrine festival. Just soon after she wears it, he suddenly holds her down. She gives a shriek, but she is surrounded by the islanders. This is just the beginning of her nightmare.   • 英語名: Nise Kyouso

别名

  • Nomad 10th Anniversary ニセ教祖 ダウンロード版

あらすじ

Masahito is a uni student, living lazily. One day, he meets a group of two girls at shrine. They believe him as the reincarnate of the founder of their religious group because his name is the same. Masahito refuses to compromise but they confine him. At first, he is confused and frightened, but his life there is better than he expects… a life full of sex. He finally decides to be the successor.
